brand.name: SoleFresh
brand.support: A reusable shoe-care product designed to manage odor and moisture and keep footwear fresher between wears.

segments.orgNote: Designed for shared and high-use footwear.

items.name: Athletes and everyday wearers

what.heading: What it does.
what.lede: Three functions in one reusable product.

hotspots.label: Odor
hotspots.text: Designed to help manage the odors that build up in shoes through repeated use.

hotspots.label: Moisture
hotspots.text: Designed to help address dampness from sweat and everyday activity.

hotspots.label: Fragrance
hotspots.text: A fragrance component intended to leave shoes smelling fresher between wears.

note.text: Built for repeated use, not thrown away.

steps.title: Finish wearing your shoes
steps.caption: Take them off after practice, a shift, or a session.

steps.title: Place SoleFresh inside
steps.caption: Set it inside the shoe while the shoe is not being worn.

steps.title: Let it work between wears
steps.caption: It stays inside while the shoes rest.

steps.title: Remove and reuse
steps.caption: Take it out before the next wear. Put it back after.

inside.heading: What's inside.
inside.note: Current prototype design (v3.2). Materials are still being tested.
inside.prompt: Select a part to see what it does.

layers.name: Shell bottom
layers.role: 3D-printed PETG. Holds the divider and the scent bay.

layers.name: Carbon sachet
layers.role: Activated carbon in a sealed fabric pouch, facing the insole. For odor.

layers.name: Silica sachet
layers.role: Silica gel beads in a sealed fabric pouch. For moisture.

layers.name: Scent beads
layers.role: Pre-scented aroma beads at the heel end. For fragrance.

layers.name: Shell top
layers.role: 3D-printed PETG. Snaps onto the bottom half.

layers.name: Pull cord
layers.role: Lets you pull it out of the shoe.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: SoleFresh is a student-founded startup developed through the INCubatoredu program. This page covers what you send us through the forms on this site.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.text: The facility pilot form asks for your organization's name and type, your name and email, and optionally the approximate pairs of shoes you manage, a phone number and a message. The waitlist form asks for your email.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.text: We'll only use this to contact you about SoleFresh.

sections.heading: Where it goes
sections.text: When you submit a form, this site's server passes your details to Google Sheets, a Google service. They are saved as a row in a private spreadsheet in a Google account we control, on Google's servers. We keep them for as long as we need them to contact you about SoleFresh, and delete them when you ask. See {googlePrivacy}.

sections.heading: This site
sections.text: This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics. It remembers the audience you picked in your browser for the current visit, so the pilot form can fill in your organization type. Its fonts load from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address. To stop repeat submissions, the server briefly holds your IP address in memory. The site is hosted on Vercel.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.text: To see, change or delete what you've sent us, email {email}.
